text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Net migration to England and the United Kingdom as a share of the
Number of people moving to the country each year, minus the number leaving, as a share of its population. The brown line
shows figures for England from 1541 to 1854; these estimates are reconstructed from church records. The orange line
shows figures for the UK from 1855; these are based on passenger counts, surveys, and administrative records.

tspan.tspan: Bank of England (2017); UK Office for National Statistics (2026); Population based on various sources (2024)
Positive values mean more people arrived than left; negative values mean more people left than arrived.
